news.title: Crypto for Advisors: It’s time for tokenization to get to work
Bitcoin holds near $65,000 as $800 billion AI selloff leaves crypto largely untouched
news.summary: The Magnificent Seven had their worst day since April 2025 after Alphabet and Tesla spooked investors on AI spending. Bitcoin fell less than 1%, and dogecoin led the majors lower.
